group.ending.entry.visual-intro.content: The default visual library is next: editable project shaders and compiled performance presets.
group.ending.entry.visual-grade.content: Bloom, vignette and warm color grading can be combined, then stopped independently.
group.ending.entry.visual-depth.content: Layer Z depth of field: the portrait at Z=10 is sharp and the background at Z=0 is blurred.
group.ending.entry.visual-focus.content: The focus moved to Z=0: the background is now sharp and the portrait is blurred.
group.ending.entry.visual-impact.content: Jump, nod, character shake, animated radial and directional lines, then a combined impact. Every temporary overlay is cleaned up.
group.ending.entry.visual-transitions.co: A directional soft wipe, two-pass blur crossfade, and image-mask dissolve. This example uses the brightness of an ordinary project image as the mask.
